headline: The seven-day drought broke overnight and the backfill clears you - five sessions, 127 minutes of hidden Z2, and a gate that says take the open sea easy.
body:
Every dark day landed at once. training.json is stamped **9 October 21:32**, **10.5 hours** old - first push in thirteen windows - and it closes 3 to 9 October on evidence.

Five sessions in seven days, and three of those Cardio logs were not only lifting. **4, 5 and 6 October carry 48, 40 and 39 minutes of plateau at 135, 132 and 136 bpm**, churn of 6.6, 7.1 and 4.8 bpm per bucket. **127 minutes of Z2** - Wattbike race effort to the bpm - that six dark mornings could not see. Gym first, as always.

Today is the easy version: **hrv 65 then 59 against a 68.6 mean** fires the gate. Rhr **41**, the lowest of all 61 rows, argues the other way. The rule wins.

So take the sea, gently. **21 km/h gust, 17 C, open water good until 11:00** - **1,200-1,500 m at 2:20-2:35/100 m**, no sprint off the start. Sunday 06:00 is calmer at **17**; Monday gusts **74** and shuts everything. Last swim file: **12 September**.

The ankle? **27 days** without a run file.
